high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from a photo editing app, showing a black-and-white filter selection interface. The main focus of the image is a close-up photograph of a person's back and head, taken from behind. The person has wet hair, suggesting they might have just showered or bathed. The background includes a textured wall and what looks like a window with a grid pattern. The photo editing app interface at the bottom of the screen offers several filter options: "Onyx," "Eiffel," "Vogue," and "Vista." Each filter option is accompanied by a small preview of how the photo would look
